source_records.title: Add bounded unit semantic alignment trace debug artifact for inspect_only
source_records.body:
## Goal

Add a bounded inspect-only debug/facts artifact that explains why each Review Unit has its current semantic alignment outcome.

## Acceptance criteria

- Existing semantic spine artifacts are reused.
- A bounded `unit_semantic_alignment_trace` debug artifact is persisted in `inspect_only_debug_artifacts`.
- `/state?debug=true` can expose the trace through existing debug artifact plumbing.
- Facts collector exports compact trace summary and per-unit diagnostics.
- No new semantic intake artifact is created.
- No new semantic binding model is created.
- No LLM is added.
- No Review Unit boundary/grouping/workstream behavior changes.
- No normal debug=false UI changes.
- Golden PR report makes `exceeds_scope` root-cause analysis possible without guessing from final counts alone.

source_records.title: 573 add bounded unit semantic alignment trace debug artifact for inspect only
source_records.body: Implemented as diagnostics/facts/debug-only. This PR reuses the existing semantic spine, adds a bounded unit_semantic_alignment_trace artifact under inspect_only_debug_artifacts, and exposes compact facts via collect_review_map_fixture_facts. No LLM, no semantic-intake model, no Review Unit boundary changes, and no normal debug=false UI changes.

evidence.summary: The trace builder consumes existing inspection units, alignment projections, change projections, and language-source rows.
The builder applies unit, reference, and excerpt limits; inspect-only state persists its bounded output.
The existing debug section manifest exposes unit_semantic_alignment_trace through the existing debug path.
The facts collector exports aggregate trace counts and compact per-unit diagnostics, preferring the persisted artifact.
The collector exports reason buckets, source usage, unresolved refs, alignment basis, and per-unit stage counts that can support diagnosis.
